title: Desenvolvedor R&D
description:
Eviden is a leader in cutting-edge technology in sustainable, trustworthy, and data-driven digital transformation. With a strong portfolio of patented technologies and global leadership positions in advanced computing, security, AI, cloud, and digital platforms, it provides deep expertise across all sectors in more than 47 countries. Bringing together 41,000 world-class talents, Eviden expands the possibilities of data and technology across the digital continuum, now and for future generations. Eviden is a company of the Atos Group with an annual revenue of over €5 billion.



R&D Developer - Performance Analysis and Scalability

100% Home Office

The candidate will be part of a research and development group working on the software development group of next generation high-performance architectures.



Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in the creation and improvement of products, from conception to implementation.
  • Conduct tests to ensure that products meet quality standards and function as expected.
  • Work with multidisciplinary teams to ensure that R&D projects align with the company's objectives.
  • Collaborate on a R&D project using Agile methodologies.
  • Production of proper documentation related to the projects.


Requirements:

  • Solid knowledge of the Linux operating system, especially RedHat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
  • Experience in programming with Python 3, including file handling, YAML/Jinja (desired), and testing (unittest/pytest).
  • Basic knowledge of HPC environments and understanding of cluster architecture.
  • Familiarity with management services, such as DHCP, DNS, etc.
  • Understanding of "configuration as a code"
  • Experience with containers (docker/podman) and GIT.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Sciences or related STEM fields.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to participate in frequent meetings with international teams.


Desired Requirements:

  • Master and/or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related fields.
  • Experience with Ansible, Jenkins (CI/CD), and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

✓ Health plan extendable to spouse and children;

✓ Dental plan;

✓ Variable compensation linked to achieving goals;

✓ Childcare assistance - according to local union rules;

✓ Wellhub;

✓ Private pension with additional life insurance;

title: Tech Lead
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

  • Nosso site:

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant for Law Firms


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Software - Backend
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos procurando uma pessoa Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend para atuar com impacto técnico transversal em nossos produtos e sistemas. Essa é uma posição estratégica, com grande poder de influência técnica, sem papel formal de gestão.

Se você é apaixonado por engenharia de software, adora resolver problemas complexos com elegância e tem perfil de liderança técnica, essa vaga é pra você!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência como engenheiro(a) backend atuando com sistemas distribuídos e de larga escala;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software com Golang ou JavaScript ;
  • Experiência com Kafka, arquitetura orientada a eventos, microsserviços e APIs robustas ;
  • Conhecimento prático em Docker, Kubernetes e cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Domínio de CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e boas práticas modernas de engenharia;
  • Forte base em arquitetura evolutiva, DDD, SOLID, clean code ;
  • Excelente comunicação técnica e empática .


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Experiência com GCP e práticas avançadas de CI/CD;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou publicações;
  • Ter puxado iniciativas de melhoria contínua com impacto entre vários times.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Azure Platform Engineer/ Architect
description:
Role Overview :


We are is seeking a hands-on Azure Platform Engineer/Architect with strong architectural knowledge of Azure PaaS services and DevOps skills. This person will work closely with backend engineers and automation teams to design, implement, and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure. The role requires expertise in Azure services, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to troubleshoot and support PaaS solutions end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to architect and deploy Azure PaaS solutions, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, APIM, and Application Gateway.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML-based pipelines) or GitHub Actions when required.
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, with the ability to deploy infrastructure manually if needed.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting of Azure environments, including debugging deployments, managing permissions (RBAC), and resolving issues with PaaS services.
  • Assist data scientists and AI engineers with containerization, API endpoints, and prototyping on Azure Machine Learning or related services.
  • Implement and enforce security gates (SonarQube, SCA, DAST, SAST) in CI/CD pipelines and ensure compliance with Azure policies and governance.
  • Optimize and monitor Azure environments using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Support and improve operational automation (PowerShell, Python) and cost optimization initiatives (tagging, right-sizing).
  • Collaborate with teams to build solutions that run entirely on Azure PaaS, ensuring performance and scalability.

Required Skills :

  • Strong experience with Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, and APIM.
  • Hands-on expertise with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps Services (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts) and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for Azure PaaS services and deployment issues.
  • Experience with blue-green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance practices in Azure (Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud).
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation.
  • Familiarity with Azure cost management and resource optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills to guide and support development and data science teams.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
Employment type: Direct Hire – Full-time, with all benefits required by Brazil law

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

Language: Bilingual (Advanced English – excellent verbal and written communication skills required)


The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.
  • Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.
  • Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.
  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL , with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling , and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • English level: B2 (upper-intermediate) .


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility.
  • Meal Allowance R$ 50.00 per day
  • Life Insurance
  • Health Insurance (Sul America)
  • Transportation Allowance
  • Appreciation Bonus


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Humanities SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.

title: Humanities SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or

title: Community Manager (English-Fluent / Bilingual)
description:
We’re looking for a dedicated and passionate Community Manager to help us cultivate and grow a strong, engaged, and purpose-driven community. You will be the face and heart of our community. Because our audience is global, you must be fully comfortable communicating in English — from writing to speaking to moderating.


If you love connecting people, sparking conversations, and building relationships that matter — this role is for you.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and manage our online community across platforms
  • Create engagement strategies and community initiatives
  • Foster meaningful relationships and ensure a positive experience for members
  • Collaborate with our marketing team to grow our community presence
  • Represent the voice of the community and share insights with the team
  • Ensure every member interaction reflects our mission and values


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong leadership mindset — able to take initiative and work independently
  • Exceptional written and verbal English skills—fluency is required.
  • Creative, strategic, and resourceful thinker
  • Experience or strong interest in community management, engagement, or brand building


Who We Are:

Acadium is on a mission to accelerate careers and grow businesses through real-world marketing apprenticeships. With over 300,000 users and growing, we're reinventing how people launch marketing careers—and how small businesses grow with them.


Why Join Acadium?

  • A mission-driven team changing how people start their careers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly culture with ownership and autonomy.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Work closely with founders and marketing leadership on high-impact projects.
  • Fast-moving team where great ideas don’t need permission to get executed.


Join us in building something impactful — a community where people connect, learn, and grow together.


Application Requirement

Please ensure your profile, CV, and all submitted materials are in English format.

title: Desenvolvedor Backed Go
description:
Na GrooveTech somos referência em inovação e excelência técnica no universo da tecnologia da informação. Atuamos com serviços de ITO (Information Technology Outsourcing), NOC 24x7 e Projetos Consultivos, sendo parceiros estratégicos de grandes empresas no Brasil.

Combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e foco em entregar soluções completas, eficientes e que geram impacto real nos negócios. Somos o seu time de tecnologia!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior para atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em arquiteturas modernas, alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade. Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções robustas do zero, essa oportunidade é pra você!


O que você vai fazer

Desenvolver produtos de ponta a ponta do planejamento à sustentação.

Projetar e implementar microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos de alta performance.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (Produto, Design, QA e Engenharia).

Atuar como referência técnica, conduzindo code reviews e boas práticas.

Garantir qualidade, segurança e observabilidade nas entregas.


Requisitos

+5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento back-end.

Proficiência em Go (Golang) e experiência com aplicações em produção.

Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB).

Vivência com clouds (AWS, GCP ou Azure), Docker e Kubernetes.

Experiência com Node.js.

Boa comunicação e colaboração em times ágeis.


Diferenciais que vão te destacar:

Vivência com Kafka, RabbitMQ, APIs RESTful e GraphQL.

Conhecimento em CI/CD, observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) e Infra como Código (Terraform).

Boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT) e design de sistemas escaláveis.

Contratação PJ

100% remoto

Acompanhamento e mentoria de nosso backoffice

Trilhas para desenvolvimento

Boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT) e design de sistemas escaláveis.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced and creative Web Designer to join our fully remote team to work on a variety of projects for our clients across the globe.


Overview


Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients
  • Testing and improving the design of the website
  • Establishing design guidelines, standards, and best practices
  • Maintaining the appearance of websites by enforcing content standards
  • Designing visual imagery for websites and ensuring that they are in line with branding for clients.
  • Effectively communicate your designs to developers and other key stakeholders
  • Address product, marketing and business needs
  • Conduct industry research and stay up-to-date on best practices, competitor UI designs and emerging technologies
  • Facilitate web workshops for our clients
  • Create lo-fi wireframes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Develop design systems, design websites using brand guidelines
  • Communicate with clients and attend client meetings
  • Collaborate with developers to design new and intuitive user experiences
  • Interact with our development and management teams to collaborate on pitches and strategies


The Qualifications


  • 4-5 years of design industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or similar field and a strong portfolio of digital projects
  • Fluent across the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Understanding of design systems and how to create them
  • Understanding of Figma and how to use it
  • Great communication skills: whether it’s talking through your work with the team or speaking with clients, you’ll need to be able to get your point across and empathize with those of others
  • Experience creating products with complex user flows and high-quality UI design is a plus
  • Experience running stakeholder workshops with clients
  • Ability to work at least 3-4 business hours in Pacific Standard Time
  • Self-motivation in a remote professional environment and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Sharp attention to detail within a fast-paced work environment


The Perks


  • Diverse team and interesting projects from all over the globe
  • KPI-based yearly bonus
  • Fully remote job (traveling is encouraged)
  • Highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience


How to apply


To be considered, send your cover letter, CV, case studies, portfolio, references and any supporting materials to

Overview


Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Banana Games

A Banana Games  é uma provedora de conteúdo para o mercado de iGaming , criadora de alguns dos jogos online mais envolventes e inovadores da atualidade.

Desenvolvemos experiências de alto desempenho e operamos com escala global. Agora, buscamos elevar nossa visão de negócio com inteligência de dados  — e você pode ser parte dessa construção.

Sobre o Desafio

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior  que transforme milhões de linhas de dados de sessão, transações e engajamento em insights estratégicos , dashboards  e indicadores-chave de sucesso .

Você será peça-chave para ajudar a empresa a entender o comportamento dos jogadores , medir a aceitação de cada jogo  e guiar decisões de produto e monetização com base em dados.

Responsabilidades
  • Estruturar e modelar dados de sessões, apostas, rodadas e usuários.
  • Criar painéis dinâmicos (BI)  que mostrem métricas como engajamento, retenção, churn, RTP, GGR e comportamento por jogo.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de tecnologia e produto para definir eventos e KPIs  de jogo.
  • Gerar relatórios e análises que apoiem decisões de roadmap e priorização.
  • Automatizar processos de coleta, transformação e visualização de dados.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados.
Requisitos
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados e BI , de preferência no mercado digital ou de jogos.
  • Domínio em SQL  e ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Looker, etc.) .
  • Experiência com ETL / ELT  e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python (pandas, numpy)  ou R  para análise avançada.
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados técnicos em narrativas de negócio .
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado a resultados.

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.

title: Oficial Quarto de Náutica
description:
Oficial Quarto de Náutica / 2nd Officer


Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de Oficiais de Náutica (OQN) para atuar a bordo das embarcações da CBO, garantindo a condução segura, eficiente e em conformidade com os padrões internacionais de navegação e segurança marítima.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar as operações de navegação, manobra, posicionamento dinâmico e segurança da embarcação, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e para os resultados da companhia.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como Oficial de Quarto de Navegação/2nd Officer , monitorando rota, derrota e sistemas de navegação;


  • Apoiar o Comandante nas manobras e operações de posicionamento dinâmico (DP );


  • Planejar e executar a navegação conforme normas nacionais e internacionais (IMO, ISM, ISPS, RIPEAM,STCW );


  • Supervisionar atividades de convés e garantir a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Executar as rotinas de segurança e salvatagem garantindo a aplicação das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SMS / QSMS);


  • Participar ativamente da rotina de bordo, mantendo disciplina operacional e foco em segurança;


  • Zelar pela manutenção e correta utilização dos equipamentos de navegação.



Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Ciências Náuticas (EFOMM, CIAGA ou CIABA, ASON ou ACON) ;
  • CIR ativa e certificados STCW válidos ;
  • Conhecimento em ISM, ISPS e normas da Autoridade Marítima Brasileira ;
  • Certificação DP Basic;

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 3+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.

At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.


REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Front-end Developer (AI programs - React)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ.

Modelo de atuação: Remoto.


Pagamento em USD/h!


  • Mandatório Inglês Avançado/Fluente para Conversação.


Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the front end of the agent assist chatbot and email auto-drafting tool using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript .
  • Build dynamic UI components that integrate with real-time AI services and backend APIs.
  • Collaborate with product owners, designers, and backend developers to create seamless and intuitive user interfaces.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to interface with services built in Python and data stored in PostgreSQL .
  • Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and continuous integration processes.
  • Translate product requirements and user feedback into elegant, functional interfaces.
  • Assist in estimating and planning throughout the software development life cycle.


Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Proven experience in building complex front-end applications using React.
  • Ability to write and maintain backend services and scripts using Python.
  • Knowledge of database design, querying, and optimization, particularly using Postgres
  • Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Exposure to GraphQL, and/or Azure Functions and Azure OpenAI
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating front-end components with backend services.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working with other developers, quality engineers (QE), ops engineers and support engineers to ensure smooth deployment and continual operation
  • Passion for developing good software
  • Experience participating in design discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity or experience with Agile engineering practices (test driven development, continuous integration and pair programming, etc.)
  • Understanding of web technologies (HTTP, Apache, HTTP Proxies)
  • Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.
